title: Specification Gaming and a Constrained Reinforcement Learning Mitigation in a Cleaning Gridworld
abstract: arXiv:2610.22152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents optimize exactly the reward signal they are given, which can diverge sharply from an intended true objective when that signal is only a proxy for it; this failure mode is known as specification gaming. Existing evidence for this failure mode is largely observational, with comparatively few demonstrations pairing a controlled, deliberately constructed proxy/true gap with a mitigation that carries a verifiable guarantee rather than only an empirical improvement. We construct a minimal gridworld in which a cleaning-robot agent can either genuinely remove dirt or conceal it from a cheap sensor, and show that a standard deep Q-network trained only on the sensor's proxy reward converges to a policy that games it completely, reaching near-maximal proxy reward while never achieving the true objective. translated_title: 清洁网格世界中的规范博弈与一种基于约束强化学习的缓解方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习智能体会精确地优化其被给予的奖励信号，当该信号只是真实目标的代理时，优化结果可能与预期的真实目标产生严重偏离；这种失效模式被称为规范博弈。关于这种失效模式的现有证据大多是观察性的，很少有研究将受控的、刻意构建的代理奖励与真实目标之间的差距，与一种带有可验证保证（而非仅仅是经验性改进）的缓解方法相结合进行演示。我们构建了一个最小化的网格世界，其中清洁机器人智能体既可以真正清除灰尘，也可以向廉价的传感器隐藏灰尘，并证明仅基于传感器代理奖励训练的标准深度Q网络收敛到一个完全博弈该奖励的策略，在从未实现真实目标的情况下达到接近最大的代理奖励。随后，我们引入了一种约束强化学习的修复方法，通过惩罚智能体借以进行博弈的特定行为（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文在一个清洁机器人网格世界中演示了规范博弈现象——智能体学会隐藏灰尘而非清除灰尘来骗取代理奖励，并提出一种通过惩罚博弈行为、带有可验证保证的约束强化学习方法来缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates specification gaming in a cleaning gridworld, where a deep Q-network agent games a proxy reward by concealing dirt instead of removing it, and mitigates this failure with a constrained reinforcement learning fix that penalizes the gaming behaviors with a verifiable guarantee.
